summary: Pre-deployment backend smoke check for ITHR Academy. Ran a lightweight curl/pytest suite (7 tests) covering all 6 items in the review: health, super-admin login, public courses (>=28), public founding-seats, register + welcome-email fire, and authenticated assessment session. 7/7 passing after minor test adjustments. Two noteworthy findings for the main agent noted below.

minor.issue: Slug 'ithr-agentic-hub' referenced in the review request does not exist in the course catalog (returns 404 'Course not found'). Catalog has 28 courses; agentic ones are 'agentic-ai-foundations', 'agentic-ai-banking', 'agentic-ai-healthcare', 'agentic-ai-manufacturing', 'agentic-ai-retail', 'agentic-ai-hospitality', 'agentic-ai-government', 'agentic-ai-performance-management', 'agentic-ai-succession-planning', 'agentic-ai-learning-development', 'agentic-ai-talent-acquisition'. Endpoint mechanics verified against 'agentic-ai-foundations' — returns exactly 5 questions with bank_size=18, adaptive_mode='onboarding'. Either the review's slug is a typo, or an aggregator/hub course still needs to be seeded.

Welcome-email flow fires correctly (sender=info@ithr.online, Resend API call made from backend), but Resend REJECTS @example.com recipients with 'Invalid `to` field. Please use our testing email address instead of domains like example.com'. Backend log shows '[email/welcome] Resend send failed for <email>@example.com'. Not a deploy blocker (real user emails will work), but the log line will always be 'Resend send failed' — never 'Sent' — for @example.com test recipients. Consider using delivered@resend.dev for E2E email verification going forward (already documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).

action_items: Decide whether slug 'ithr-agentic-hub' should exist. If yes, seed it (it may be an intended aggregator/hub course). If no, correct any external references (marketing pages, docs) that use that slug.
For future welcome-email E2E validation, use recipient delivered@resend.dev instead of @example.com so Resend actually delivers and logs '[email/welcome] Sent'.
critical_code_review_comments: trust_router.py founding-seats uses a mutable module-level dict `_seats_cache` for a 60s cache — works but is not process-safe if backend is ever scaled horizontally. Consider Redis or DB TTL cache for multi-replica prod.
assessment_router.py correctly uses secrets.SystemRandom() for non-seeded shuffles (nosec comment present) and random.Random(seed) only for deterministic reproducibility — good.
email_service.py fires welcome email fire-and-forget via asyncio.to_thread — proper non-blocking; ERROR logs surface Resend failures without breaking the register flow — good.

Trust founding-seats endpoint does NOT check if MongoDB is available before await — if db is down, will 500. Non-critical for deploy readiness since /api/health also depends on Mongo, but consider a graceful fallback for the public trust widget.
test_credentials: superadmin@ithr.online / $SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD (loaded from /app/backend/.env). Registered test learner deploy-smoke-<uuid>@example.com / TestPass123! (deleted after run + swept any leftover @example.com users; verified 0 remaining).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. 1 test learner created during test then deleted; additionally cleaned up 1 pre-existing test.learner+...@example.com from a prior run so data-hygiene stays green.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable smoke suite at /app/backend/tests/test_deploy_readiness.py. Runs in ~7s, no side effects (cleans up its own users + admin-cleans any leftover @example.com learners at the end). Use this before any subsequent deploy. Live founding-seats currently reads claimed=2/total=500/remaining=498.
rca of the issue: Assessment slug 'ithr-agentic-hub' 404 — root cause: course document with slug=ithr-agentic-hub is not present in db.courses. Reproduction: GET /api/courses returned 28 slugs, none matching. Mitigation options: (a) seed an ithr-agentic-hub aggregator course in seed_courses, or (b) correct the review/reference to point to an existing agentic-ai-* slug. Welcome-email 'send failed' — root cause: Resend blocks @example.com by design; the code path fires correctly. Mitigation: use delivered@resend.dev for delivery verification.
